statement: A settlement lists token ids, at most 32 and none twice; for each it forgives the current head debt of each side toward the other when that debt is owed to the other side of the Account, and a head owed to a third party is never touched; the whole settlement fails (BatchFailed, nothing of it applies) only when nothing was forgiven for a listed token and a debt exists there. The Arrival page models one token with debts, so the per-token revert across two listed tokens (one forgiven, one blocked) is not modelled. The Quint cell holds the same cut on one token: the head debt of each side forgiven in both directions, a head owed to a third party untouched, the revert only when nothing was forgiven and a debt exists, the cap on the listed tokens and no repeat, and the total reduced with the claims (the forgives-* and forgive-* mutants); the per-token revert across two listed tokens is not modelled there either.
